name: Tomodachi no Okaa-san wa Suki Desu ka? ~Musuko no Yuujin ni Hamatta Oba-chan Tsuma~
original_name: 友達のお母さんは好きですか?～息子の友人にハマったオバちゃん妻～
source:
Kawanami Akino spends her days busy taking care of her husband and son and handling household chores. This mature woman, who is currently in her prime, finds herself confessed to by her son’s friend after a chance encounter.

At first, Akino didn’t take the confession seriously, but she was swept away by the protagonist’s passion and intensity and she ends up having a physical relationship with him.

Akino is brought to climax again and again by sex that’s intense and rough, a far cry from the bland sex she has with her husband.

Having rediscovered the pleasures of womanhood she had long forgotten, Akino is gradually seduced into becoming her son’s friend’s woman.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ099666.html/]DLsite[/url]]
